name: Ymir
title: Worldbringer
summary: Cast avalanches and bring down the mountain on your foes with Freeze and Speed Debuffs.
lore: Ancestor of the jotnar, Ymir is a primal being who predates the gods and even the realm of Asgard. It is said the first gods crafted the world from Ymir’s flesh. He has largely slumbered since, and the Ymir encountered in Ryven represents only a sliver of this primordial power’s body and mind. His full awakening at the hands of the Primal Powers could end Asgard.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: At max stacks, will place [Freeze] on each target for 1 turn which cannot be blocked or resisted.
Also has a 50% chance to place [Freeze] if any Disable or Debuff
Each time this hero places [Freeze], reduce this hero's Divinity Cost by 10 (stacking up to 30 times) and increase the damage this hero inflicts on their next Ultimate Ability by 3%.
